alias_boundary: Causal machine learning is a field; EconML, DoWhy, grf and causal-learn are distinct engines.
preferred_proposal_route: Integrate an optional pinned Python T-learner service after scoped import/dependency review and engine fixtures.
decision_scope: Completed proposal selection and reuse review; defer executable admission, not the proposal or all other research.

license.next: Preserve the full applicable license/notice chain and review bundled/transitive materials before redistribution.

primary_evidence.anchor: Nine source blobs matched to one cutoff-eligible revision

conversion_failure_contract.anchor: Target preservation, initial profile and failure contract

behavioral_oracle.anchor: Exact imposed-law algebra and bootstrap failure probability

rationale: A narrow upstream wrapper reduces duplication of meta-learner and bootstrap maintenance.
A source review cannot qualify the package import chain, dependency environment or its interval behavior.
Ranking and flexible regression do not solve confounding, observation errors or temporal dependence.
Binary treatment avoids the observed multi-arm point/variance population mismatch until separately reviewed.

alternatives.reason: IV, neural proxies, forests, targeting and static meta-learners have different assumptions and import requirements.
No demonstrated embedding constraint justifies ownership of upstream API, bootstrap and dependency fixes.
Transparent small problem behavior supplies an oracle and shows when complex ML is unnecessary.
Use their own pins and uncertainty contracts; do not inherit CausalML admission.

costs_to_measure: fit/predict/bootstrap elapsed time and peak memory

owner_obligations.adapter_maintainer: Own pinned import path, lockfile, notices, conversions and failure preservation.
owner_obligations.scientific_reviewer: Review adjustment and sampling premises, estimator/interval meaning and registered comparator designs.
owner_obligations.workflow_owner: Define eligible accounts, information clock, feasible offers, money horizon and cost scenarios.

revisit_trigger: Inspect the selected import and input-validation path, lock its full environment and license inventory, implement the declared wrapper, and execute target/column/uncertainty/failure oracles before enabling the path.
